name: Kimi K3.1 Pro (2.8T)

release_date.note: Raschka gallery date; HF repo created 2026-11-02; one news site says 2026-10-23

mixers.note: 96 heads of 128; short conv (kernel 4) on q, k, v
gated MLA turned into gated DSA; NoPE

position.nope_layers: all; KDA layers carry order in their recurrence, MLA layers set mla_use_nope

moe.router: sigmoid scores, aux-loss-free bias (noaux_tc), top-16, renormalised, one group

stack.note: 1-based config lists: KDA at layers not divisible by 4 up to 91; DSA at 4, 8, ... 92 and 93

steps.label: KDA: conv on q, k, v; q, k L2-normed; fine-grained decay; gated RMSNorm on output
DSA indexer, 32 heads x 128, no RoPE, keeps 2048 tokens
added to the block's running sum
top-16 of 896 at width 3584 with a norm on the latent; 2 shared experts on the full 7168 width (layer 1: dense SiTU-GLU 33792)

specials.name: attention_residuals
specials.what: Block Attention Residuals, block size 12 layers; extra output_attn_res before the head

specials.name: latent_moe
specials.what: Stable LatentMoE: routed experts work at 3584 wide, with a norm on the latent

specials.name: sparse_topk
specials.what: DSA indexer (32 heads x 128, no RoPE) picks 2048 past tokens

specials.name: gated_attention
specials.what: output gate on MLA (mla_use_output_gate) and g_proj on KDA

specials.name: short_conv
specials.what: kernel-4 convolutions on KDA queries, keys and values

readme.note: Model Summary table and footnote on Gated DSA

paper.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
paper.note: describes the K3 base; abstract and listing only were read

gal.note: entry 'Kimi K3.1 Pro': date, '69 KDA + 24 Gated DSA', NoPE, eight attention-residual groups

code.note: Kimi K3's own modeling code (KimiDecoderLayer._forward_attn_residual); K3.1 Pro keeps the same config class and architecture string, adding dsa_config

sgl.note: serves K3 and K3.1: MLA built with skip_rope=True (NoPE); DSA indexer loaded when dsa_config is set

figure_links.author: Sebastian Raschka
figure_links.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro (2.8T), the screenshot diagram
figure_links.terms: no reuse licence stated; link only

unknowns.attention.qk_norm: no q/k norm tensors in the index; MLA latents have their own norms (q_a_layernorm, kv_a_layernorm)

notes: Config keeps qk_rope_head_dim 64 while setting mla_use_nope; SGLang builds these layers with skip_rope=True, so they apply no rotary.
kv_heads 96 is nominal for MLA, as for DeepSeek-V3.
No modeling file ships in the K3.1 Pro repo; the block order comes from K3's code, which reads the same config keys, and SGLang's kimi_k3.py, which serves both.

kda.note: short conv kernel 4 on q, k, v; layer 1 has a dense FFN

dsa.note: gated MLA plus DSA top-2048; q/k heads 128 + 64 unrotated dims, v 128
